package.name: dedocs
package.description: Single-file, package-exact, AI-native source for .docx documents.

principles: One text file contains the whole .docx package.
The exact package core stays the source of truth.
Generated guides help orientation but never affect fidelity.
Semantic transforms stay explicit and fail loudly on anchor drift.
Untouched package parts are preserved byte-for-byte.
guarantees: Guides are advisory only and can be regenerated at any time.
Untouched XML is not normalized or reserialized.
Binary parts stay intact as base64 payload blocks.
Zip container timestamps and compression metadata are intentionally out of scope.

commands.name: decompile
commands.summary: Flatten a .docx package into one dedocs file.

commands.name: compile
commands.summary: Rebuild a .docx package from the single-file source.

commands.name: normalize
commands.summary: Refresh hashes, boundaries, and generated guides after hand edits.

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: Compare two .docx packages part-by-part and report exact diffs.

transforms.summary: Apply a literal replacement inside one UTF-8 package part.
Apply inline formatting to a matched span inside one document paragraph.
Attach a Word comment to a matched text span.
Insert a footnote reference and create the footnote entry.
Replace an entire paragraph while preserving paragraph properties by default.
Insert a new paragraph before an anchored paragraph.
Insert a new paragraph after an anchored paragraph.
Delete an anchored paragraph from the document body.
Insert a block table after an anchored paragraph from TSV content.
Insert a block figure after an anchored paragraph using an existing image part.
